home.aboutP1: Indeed, we specialize in the installation, storage, and management of signage materials for real estate brokers for nearly 15 years. We offer reliable and fast service throughout the Greater Montreal region and surrounding areas to clients who seek to optimize their time and who value quality service. Whether you are a real estate broker, developer, event organizer, or other professional, we have solutions to simplify your signage management and allow you to focus on what truly matters: managing your projects.
home.aboutP2: By opening an account with Pancarte Express, you'll have access to all our installation, storage, and management services for your signs, panels, signage, mailboxes, flags, posts, anchors, large commercial structures, temporary displays, and balcony and wall installations, plus many other solutions. You'll also benefit from customized offers for your sector and flexible installation options tailored to your needs. We are proud to have earned the trust of over 300 clients and we are committed to maintaining this relationship through our professionalism and dedication to quality.

becomeMember.title: Account Opening
becomeMember.subTitle: Becoming a member at PANCARTE EXPRESS means enjoying numerous benefits
becomeMember.warehouseDesc: Storage, maintenance and management of your inventory. You receive an alert when your inventory is low or signs are damaged, as well as a promotional code with our partner Tout Pour Le Courtier to get discounts on your signage material orders.
becomeMember.placementDesc: In addition to this rate, you benefit from a geographic territory that is yours exclusively, and within which prices are even more advantageous! (contact us for more information)
becomeMember.urgencyDesc: An emergency service to get installations the same day
becomeMember.andMoreDesc1: A correction list at a special rate can be requested twice a year to ensure all your installations are straight and secure
becomeMember.andMoreDesc2: Confirmation photos are sent for each installation, as well as an order history and a monthly invoice grouping all requests

becomeMember.group: Yes, I am part of a broker team
